value.signature: fn project_retirements (current : & [PathStep] , originals : & [OriginalEpoch < '_ >] , selected_epoch : u64 , active_limit : usize ,) -> Result < Vec < KeyHash > , ScanError >

review.body: { let mut boundary = current . first () . ok_or (ScanError :: MissingEvidence) ? . txid ; for (index , original) in originals . iter () . enumerate () { if original . epoch != u64 :: try_from (index) . map_err (| _ | ScanError :: Budget) ? || original . epoch >= selected_epoch { return Err (ScanError :: MissingEvidence) ; } let mut maximum = original . path . iter () . position (| step | step . txid == boundary) . ok_or (ScanError :: MissingEvidence) ? ; for request in original . requests { if request . epoch != original . epoch { return Err (ScanError :: MissingEvidence) ; } if let Some (position) = original . path . iter () . position (| step | step . txid == request . point) { maximum = maximum . max (position) ; } } boundary = original . path [maximum] . txid ; } if originals . len () != usize :: try_from (selected_epoch) . map_err (| _ | ScanError :: Budget) ? { return Err (ScanError :: MissingEvidence) ; } let boundary = current . iter () . position (| step | step . txid == boundary) . ok_or (ScanError :: MissingEvidence) ? ; active_keys (current , boundary , active_limit) }
review.item_premise: Complete supplied public block layouts are scanned with caller-selected finite bounds. The resulting key histories are conditional public evidence, not signed-chain or account-binding truth.
